title: 剪頭髮講清楚要什麼
subtitle: 12 句英文，不再剪完回家哭

lines.say: So, what are we doing today?
lines.zh: 今天想怎麼剪？

lines.say: Em… just a little shorter, please.
lines.zh: 呃……剪短一點點就好。

lines.say: There you go! What do you think?
lines.zh: 好了！你覺得怎麼樣？

lines.say: I said a little shorter. He heard: do whatever you like. I lost fifteen centimetres that day.
lines.zh: 我說剪短一點點，他聽到的是「隨便你剪」。那天我少了十五公分的頭髮。

lines.say: And when he asked: do you like it? I said: yes, lovely! Then I cried on the bus.
lines.zh: 他問我喜不喜歡，我說：喜歡，很好看！然後在公車上哭。

board.cta: 剪頭髮講清楚・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for the hairdresser or the barber.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你去髮廊或理髮店的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for the hairdresser or the barber.

lines.say: How to say exactly what you want, how to stop them in the middle, and how to say you're not happy.
lines.zh: 怎麼精確說出你要的、怎麼中途喊停，還有怎麼說你不滿意。

lines.say: Part one: say what you want.
lines.zh: 第一段：說出你要的。

lines.say: A little means something different to everyone. So we use numbers and pictures.
lines.zh: 「一點點」每個人的定義都不同，所以要用數字和照片。

items: ✗ a little shorter
✓ about two centimetres
✓ just a trim

lines.say: Never say only: a little shorter.
lines.zh: 永遠不要只說 a little shorter。

lines.say: Give a number, or use the magic word: a trim.
lines.zh: 給一個數字，或用這個神奇的字：a trim。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Just a trim, please. About two centimetres off the ends.
scenes.meaning: 稍微修一下就好，髮尾剪掉兩公分左右
scenes.note: a trim ＝ 稍微修剪　off the ends ＝ 從髮尾

lines.say: Just a trim, please. About two centimetres off the ends.
A trim is a very small cut, just to tidy it. The ends are the tips of your hair.
lines.zh: trim 是稍微修剪整齊，ends 是髮尾。

lines.say: Show the two centimetres with your fingers as well. Fingers don't lie.
lines.zh: 同時用手指比出兩公分，手指不會騙人。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Just a trim, please. About two centimetres off the ends.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: I'd like to keep the length, but take some weight out.
scenes.meaning: 長度我想留著，但幫我打薄一點
scenes.note: take some weight out ＝ 打薄

lines.say: If your hair feels heavy, but you love it long, say this.
lines.zh: 如果覺得頭髮很厚重，但又想留長，就說這一句。

lines.say: I'd like to keep the length, but take some weight out.
Keep the length means don't make it shorter. Take some weight out means make it thinner and lighter.
lines.zh: keep the length 是不要剪短，take some weight out 是打薄、變輕。

lines.say: Saying what you want to keep is just as important as what you want to change.
lines.zh: 說出你想保留的，跟說出你想改的一樣重要。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'd like to keep the length, but take some weight out.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I've got a photo. Could you do something like this?
scenes.meaning: 我有照片，可以剪成類似這樣嗎？
scenes.note: something like this ＝ 類似這樣

lines.say: And the best tool of all is in your pocket.
lines.zh: 而最好用的工具，就在你的口袋裡。

lines.say: I've got a photo. Could you do something like this?
Something like this means similar, not exactly the same. That's fair. Your hair is not the model's hair.
lines.zh: something like this 是「類似」，不是一模一樣。這很合理，你的髮質跟模特兒不同。

lines.say: Hairdressers love photos. One picture saves a hundred words.
lines.zh: 設計師最喜歡照片，一張圖勝過一百個字。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've got a photo. Could you do something like this?
Part two: the details.
lines.zh: 第二段：講細節。

lines.say: Now you need a few hair words. Don't worry, there are only three.
lines.zh: 現在需要幾個頭髮的單字。別擔心，只有三個。

items: fringe　瀏海
layers　層次
the sides and the back　兩側和後面

lines.say: A fringe is the hair over your forehead. Americans call it bangs.
lines.zh: fringe 是額頭前的瀏海，美國人叫 bangs。

lines.say: Layers are different lengths cut into your hair, to give it shape.
lines.zh: layers 是剪出不同長度的層次，讓頭髮有型。

lines.say: And for short hair, you talk about the sides and the back.
lines.zh: 短髮的話，會講兩側和後面。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Could you leave the fringe a bit longer?
scenes.note: leave it longer ＝ 留長一點

lines.say: Could you leave the fringe a bit longer?
Leave it longer means don't cut too much there.
lines.zh: leave it longer 是那裡不要剪太多。

lines.say: A fringe that's too short takes two months to fix. So be careful with this one!
lines.zh: 瀏海剪太短要兩個月才救得回來，所以這句很重要！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you leave the fringe a bit longer?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Short on the sides, but not too short on top.
scenes.meaning: 兩側短，但頭頂不要太短
scenes.note: on the sides ＝ 兩側　on top ＝ 頭頂

lines.say: This one is for shorter haircuts.
lines.zh: 這一句是短髮用的。

lines.say: Short on the sides, but not too short on top.
We say on the sides and on top. The little word is on.
lines.zh: 說 on the sides、on top，介系詞是 on。

lines.say: Barbers may ask what number you want. That's the machine. A one is very short, a four is longer.
lines.zh: 理髮師可能會問你要幾號，那是指電推。一號很短，四號比較長。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Short on the sides, but not too short on top.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I usually wear it parted on the left.
scenes.note: parted on the left ＝ 左分

lines.say: And tell them how you normally wear it.
lines.zh: 還要告訴對方你平常怎麼整理。

lines.say: I usually wear it parted on the left.
Your parting is the line in your hair. Parted on the left means the line is on the left side.
lines.zh: parting 是頭髮的分線，parted on the left 是分線在左邊。

lines.say: We say wear your hair, just like wearing clothes.
lines.zh: 頭髮的造型用 wear 這個動詞，跟穿衣服一樣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I usually wear it parted on the left.
Now the same visit, with clear instructions.
lines.zh: 同樣去剪頭髮，這次把話講清楚。

lines.say: So, what are we doing today?
lines.zh: 今天想怎麼剪？

lines.say: Just a trim, please. About two centimetres off the ends.
lines.zh: 稍微修一下就好，髮尾剪掉兩公分左右。

lines.say: No problem. And the fringe?
lines.zh: 沒問題。瀏海呢？

lines.say: Could you leave the fringe a bit longer? And I usually wear it parted on the left.
lines.zh: 瀏海可以留長一點嗎？還有，我平常是左邊分線。

lines.say: Perfect. That's really clear.
lines.zh: 完美，講得很清楚。

lines.say: He knows exactly what to do. No surprises.
lines.zh: 他完全知道要怎麼剪，不會有驚嚇。

scenes.title: Speak up
scenes.sub: 中途喊停：現在說，不要回家哭

lines.say: Part three: speak up.
lines.zh: 第三段：開口說。

lines.say: You see too much hair on the floor. Your heart is beating fast. What do you do?
lines.zh: 你看到地上的頭髮太多了，心跳加速。怎麼辦？

items: ✗ at home, crying
✓ right now, in the chair

lines.say: Most of us say nothing, because we don't want to be rude.
lines.zh: 大部分的人什麼都不說，因為不想失禮。

lines.say: But a good hairdresser wants you to speak now. They can fix it now. They can't fix it tomorrow.
lines.zh: 但好的設計師希望你現在說。現在還能調整，明天就沒辦法了。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Sorry, could we stop there for a second?
scenes.meaning: 不好意思，可以先停一下嗎？

lines.say: Sorry, could we stop there for a second?
It's short and polite, and it works immediately.
lines.zh: 這句話簡短、有禮貌，而且馬上有效。

lines.say: Could we makes it sound like teamwork, not an order.
lines.zh: 用 Could we 聽起來像合作，不像命令。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry, could we stop there for a second?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: That's as short as I'd like to go.
scenes.meaning: 這個長度就是我的極限了，不要再短
scenes.note: as short as I'd like to go ＝ 最短只能到這裡

lines.say: Then tell them clearly where the limit is.
lines.zh: 接著清楚說出你的底線。

lines.say: That's as short as I'd like to go.
As short as I'd like to go means: this is the shortest I want. No more.
lines.zh: as short as I'd like to go 是「我最短只想到這裡」，不要再剪了。

lines.say: You can use this pattern for anything. That's as far as I'd like to go. That's as much as I'd like to pay.
lines.zh: 這個句型到處都能用：最遠到這裡、最多付這些。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That's as short as I'd like to go.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: It's not quite what I had in mind.
scenes.note: not quite ＝ 不太是　had in mind ＝ 心裡想的

lines.say: And at the end, if you're not happy, here is the gentle, honest way.
lines.zh: 最後如果不滿意，溫和又誠實的說法是這一句。

lines.say: It's not quite what I had in mind.
What I had in mind is the picture that was in my head.
lines.zh: what I had in mind 是我腦中原本想的樣子。

lines.say: Not quite is very useful. It means not exactly, and it's much softer than I don't like it.
lines.zh: not quite 非常好用，意思是「不完全是」，比 I don't like it 柔和很多。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It's not quite what I had in mind.
Part four: finish well.
lines.zh: 第四段：好好收尾。

lines.say: After not quite what I had in mind, always say what would make it better.
lines.zh: 說完「跟我想的不太一樣」之後，一定要說怎樣會更好。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Could you even it up a little on this side?
scenes.meaning: 這一邊可以幫我修齊一點嗎？
scenes.note: even it up ＝ 修齊、修成對稱

lines.say: Could you even it up a little on this side?
Even means the same on both sides. Even it up means make it equal.
lines.zh: even 是兩邊一樣，even it up 是修成對稱。

lines.say: Point at the place while you say it.
lines.zh: 邊說邊指出位置。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you even it up a little on this side?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: That's much better. Thanks for fixing that.
scenes.meaning: 好多了，謝謝你幫我調整

lines.say: When they fix it, tell them.
lines.zh: 對方調整好之後，要告訴他。

lines.say: That's much better. Thanks for fixing that.
A little praise at the end means they'll remember you kindly next time.
lines.zh: 最後稱讚一下，下次他會記得你是個好客人。

lines.say: And you will come back. Finding a good hairdresser is harder than finding a flat!
lines.zh: 而且你會再回來的。找到好設計師比找房子還難！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That's much better. Thanks for fixing that.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Could I book in with you again for six weeks' time?
scenes.meaning: 我可以再跟你約六週後嗎？
scenes.note: book in with you ＝ 指定跟你預約

lines.say: And if you love it, don't lose them.
lines.zh: 如果你很滿意，就不要錯過這位設計師。

lines.say: Could I book in with you again for six weeks' time?
Book in with you means make an appointment with you, not just anyone.
lines.zh: book in with you 是指定跟你預約，不是隨便哪一位。

lines.say: In six weeks' time means six weeks from today.
lines.zh: in six weeks' time 是從今天算起六週後。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could I book in with you again for six weeks' time?
Sorry, could we stop there for a second? That's as short as I'd like to go.
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以先停一下嗎？這個長度就是我的極限了。

lines.say: Of course. Thanks for telling me.
lines.zh: 當然，謝謝你告訴我。

lines.say: Could you even it up a little on this side?
lines.zh: 這一邊可以幫我修齊一點嗎？

lines.say: There. How's that?
lines.zh: 好了，這樣呢？

lines.say: That's much better. Could I book in with you again for six weeks' time?
lines.zh: 好多了。我可以再跟你約六週後嗎？

lines.say: I'd love that. See you then!
lines.zh: 太好了，到時候見！

lines.say: I spoke up, and we're still friends.
lines.zh: 我開口了，而且我們還是朋友。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：剪完頭髮會聽到的話

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear after a haircut in Ireland.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在愛爾蘭剪完頭髮會聽到的兩句話。

lines.say: In Irish English, only can make something stronger.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭英文裡，only 可以用來加強語氣。

lines.say: Your hair is only gorgeous!
It doesn't mean just gorgeous. It means absolutely gorgeous.
lines.zh: 不是「只有漂亮」，而是「漂亮極了」。

lines.say: And the opposite. Your friends will see your new hair and ask the most obvious question.
lines.zh: 另一種相反。朋友看到你的新髮型，會問一個最明顯的問題。

lines.say: Did you get a haircut?
The Irish answer is: no, I got them all cut! It's a very old joke. You'll hear it forever.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭式的回答是：不，我是全部的頭髮都剪了！這是個老笑話，你會聽一輩子。

lines.say: No, I got them all cut!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：剪出你要的頭髮

lines.say: Let's go back to the chair one more time. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們再回到那張椅子上一次。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: So, what are we doing today?
lines.zh: 今天想怎麼剪？

lines.say: I'd like to keep the length, but take some weight out.
lines.zh: 長度我想留著，但幫我打薄一點。

lines.say: Sure. Any idea of the shape?
lines.zh: 好。有想要的樣子嗎？

lines.say: I've got a photo. Could you do something like this?
lines.zh: 我有照片，可以剪成類似這樣嗎？

lines.say: Oh, nice. That will suit you.
lines.zh: 喔，不錯，這很適合你。

lines.say: Could you leave the fringe a bit longer?
lines.zh: 瀏海可以留長一點嗎？

lines.say: You're the boss.
lines.zh: 聽你的。

items: Just a trim, please. About two centimetres off the ends.
I'd like to keep the length, but take some weight out.
I've got a photo. Could you do something like this?
Could you leave the fringe a bit longer?
Short on the sides, but not too short on top.
I usually wear it parted on the left.
Sorry, could we stop there for a second?
That's as short as I'd like to go.
It's not quite what I had in mind.
Could you even it up a little on this side?
That's much better. Thanks for fixing that.
Could I book in with you again for six weeks' time?

lines.say: Gorgeous! And nobody cried on the bus.
lines.zh: 漂亮！而且沒有人在公車上哭。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before your next haircut.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次剪頭髮前先截圖。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And yes, I did get a haircut. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 對，我有剪頭髮。下一課見，Bye！
